t.zh: 要么我坐公交，要么我骑车，不知道是哪一个。坐公交，我准时到；骑车，我也准时到。
t.en: Either I take the bus or I cycle; which, you do not know. By bus I arrive on time; by bike I arrive on time too.

t.zh: 光有「我坐公交 ∨ 我骑车」，拆不出「我坐公交」：说不定是骑车。
t.en: From “I take the bus ∨ I cycle” alone you cannot take out “I take the bus”: perhaps I cycled.

t.zh: 「或者」生成的消去规则是分情况：一条引入规则一种情况。像一个假设框，只是有两个框：情况一假设左边，情况二假设右边；两个框证出同一句话，它就给出这句话。
t.en: The elimination rule made for “or” goes case by case: one case for each introduction rule. is like an assumption box, but with two boxes: case one assumes the left, case two the right; when both prove the same sentence, it gives that sentence.

hint.zh: 放一块分类讨论，把已知「我坐公交 ∨ 我骑车」接进元件上标着「A ∨ B」的输入口。元件下半部分有两个框：情况一的「假设」是「我坐公交」，情况二的是「我骑车」。
hint.en: Place a Case analysis and wire the given “I take the bus ∨ I cycle” into the input marked “A ∨ B” on its part. The lower half of the part holds two boxes: case one’s “Assume” is “I take the bus”, case two’s “I cycle”.

hint.zh: 情况一的框里放一块套用：「我坐公交 → 我准时到」接「A → B」口，框左上角的「假设」接「A」口，结果接到这个框右上角的「结论」。情况二照样做。
hint.en: In case one’s box put an Apply: “I take the bus → I arrive on time” into its “A → B” input, the box’s “Assume” at its top left into its “A” input, and the result into “Conclusion” at the box’s top right. Do the same in case two.

hint.zh: 两个框都证出「我准时到」以后，分类讨论元件右上角的输出就是「我准时到」，接到目标。
hint.en: Once both boxes prove “I arrive on time”, the output at the Case analysis part’s top right gives “I arrive on time”: wire it to the goal.
